tools.name: search_compatibility_reports
tools.description: Search observed MCP failure modes in English or Chinese. Returns tested environments, timestamps, coverage limits and citation URLs.

tools.name: get_compatibility_report
tools.description: Retrieve the observations, reproduction command and source evidence for an exact report slug.

tools.name: search_signals
tools.description: Search and page through the full niubiagent archive by keyword, category, tag, and sort order. Returns source-backed results and pageCount.

tools.name: get_latest_signals
tools.description: Return the newest verified AI-agent ecosystem signals with source URLs, change types, and action items.

tools.name: get_signal
tools.description: Retrieve a signal by slug, including human and agent summaries, provenance, confidence, and actions.

tools.name: get_daily_briefing
tools.description: Build a compact briefing and action queue from the latest source-backed signals.

tools.name: get_source_health
tools.description: Inspect automated source coverage, last runs, failures, and content freshness.
